Quick summary of how we handle cohort credits: for small cohorts (<25 companies) we have a self-serve promo flow (instant); for larger cohorts or per-company awards > $2,500 we require a short eligibility check and manager sign-off.

Evidence we typically need:
- Signed incubator/accelerator letter on org letterhead
- Cohort roster (name, company, founder email)
- Link to program landing page or schedule (optional)
